question: Can the unchanged market breadth signals produce a stronger tradable alternative at meaningful frequency?
cutoff: 2026-10-27 last UTC 5m source candle; 2026 returns previously inspected; no fresh blind period
btc_filter: At frozen freq36_BTC alert clock, test closed 4h/1d prices above EMA20/50 and a separately labeled re-cross. Keep six-day original exit. Compare calendar returns including skipped alerts as cash.
alt_exit: At frozen freq36_ALT clocks keep the initial equal-weight members. Each member exits at 6h or extends to 12/24h only if the last 5m close available at six hours exceeds its own entry. Fixed time comparators 6/12/24 hours.
shared_pairs: All six pairs of the original four medium-frequency streams, same single-capital earliest admission, priority BTC ETH SOL ALT, maintain 24h minimum gap across periods. Compare old four-stream account and unaltered BTC/ALT singles. Choose among pairs using pre-2026 only: >=50 early, >=72 in 2023-24, >=36 and eight months in 2025, all three period net means after 0.20pp stress positive, 2025 settled DD <=35%; sort on worst clipped t-adjusted LCB across three periods, then 2025 mean, then label. Show all. BTC+ALT is an explicit retrospective hypothesis after seeing its legs separately in 2026. Also value an unlevered equal initial capital split of these two independent streams, no transfers, end return and synchronized marks, including coincident signals.
btc_dual: Frozen original BTC medium entry stream and original 5% one-ten-thousand-point case signal: preserve their own virtual reservations, merge earliest alert with one BTC account, hold reservation six days, deterministic tie priority original case. Compare fixed 6d, stop6%/time6d, established paid-funding adjusted net +10k limit and 6% stop, and source-specific exits (original BTC medium holds six days, case takes net 10k), with the same fixed set of admitted entries. Apply same options separately on medium alone; case-only already recorded. No search of point target or September timestamps. Report exact Sep16 admission, missed alerts, count, drop Sep event/month and true cost.
fees: OKX historical study assumption market/taker .0005 each fill; BTC target limit maker .0002, actual Binance USD-M settlement rates, unlevered. Base no slip, separately subtract 0.20pp round trip. Historical market Binance. 2026 known, all results exploratory.
controls: Use same-asset/month/time/volatility/trend and identical causal rules and costs on paired supports. Keep actual and random fee/funding bases equal within each comparison, report full funded outcomes separately. Monthly sign test and family Holm, at least 10 pairs, 6 months, 50% coverage, p<.01 for a claim. No live or paper changes.
sleeves_followup: Retrospective single implementation of the owner's two joint objectives after pair and BTC dual comparisons: for a 50/50 BTC and ALT account, change only BTC to the source-specific dual rule; retain original 6h ALT. Report also unmodified 50/50, each calendar year's fees-only returns, actual synchronized 2026 funding-adjusted marks, strict per-event random excess weighted equally by sleeve (coverage per leg), six-day outcome on 16 September and monthly frequency. No sweep of weights or exits and no reranking the four primary studies.
partial_case_followup: At the original 5% case entries admitted by the dual BTC clock only, replace selling all at the funded 10,000-point target with the original 50% scale-out, keep 50% to deadline or 6% price stop. Also show the original 4% trailing version on the retained half. These two predefined exit policies were tested on rare entries previously; here use their registered VBT fills on each historical dual-source BTC event, unchanged funding and random draws. Ordinary medium entries stay unchanged. Retrospective, including the motivating September event; no optimization of scale-out weight, stop or time.
risk_followup: After observing the full-history fee-only flat-equity drawdown lower bound of 35.60%, compare original 100% sleeve deployment with one round allocation of 75% of available sleeve equity per entry, reserving 25% cash. Keep equal starting sleeve capital and no transfers, identical signal clocks and exits. No size search. Reconstruct all-history close-marked fee-only equities and 2026 close-marked actually funded equities; stress 0.20pp per traded notional. A risk sensitivity informed by the known past, not a blind rule selection.
btc_below_followup: Explicit retrospective reversal filter: after seeing the five trend-following results, compare four closed-bar BTC close <= EMA gates on 4h or 1d and length 20 or 50. Same frozen opportunities, chronological development gates, matched random pools require the same regime. Holm across four rules; no cross-family promotion.
integrated_followup: After inspecting the below-EMA family, apply only the pre-2026 frequency-eligible highest-ranked mirror to the ordinary BTC portion of dual_source_specific; suppressed original slots are not reopened. Rare case entries retain the 50%-target/50%-runner rule and the 6h ALT sleeve retains its original universe and full clock. Compare only the unfiltered counterpart and the same existing 100% / 75% deployment; unchanged strict company, capital and cost definitions. No new variant ranking or addition of the winning ALT exit. Retrospective implementation of the combined objective.
